title: Mediums
summary: The living who speak with the dead.

claims.text: Natural mediums hold beliefs as varied as world religions, yet most know little of the real Shadowlands, the Hierarchy or Oblivion, and see the Underworld through a rosy haze.
Whatever their motive, most have some sense that their contact brings peace to the Restless, and many think their gift sets them slightly above other people, other mediums included.
Some chase profit and fame, working boardwalks near casinos and moving on to stage shows and television in hope of advising the rich, as Rasputin and Merlin did.
